_comment: Design tokens applied to the RFQ document.
PROVENANCE: these values come from the Seica Israel design system
(Claude Design project 16f0a237-5659-4ebf-a4ae-27ee0a19f8ee), file
colors_and_type.css. They are the design system's own tokens, translated
from CSS custom properties to Word-style RRGGBB hex.
Mapping, token by token:
--seica-navy      #1A2B5A  -> brand_dark, heading rules, table header fill
--seica-blue      #00AEEF  -> brand (the exact brand cyan)
--seica-blue-deep #0082B5  -> heading_text; the design system reserves this
variant for small text on white, and a section
heading set in #00AEEF on paper is unreadable
--bg-panel        #EAF2FA  -> class subheading fill, with navy text; the
system calls for hairlines and light panels
rather than heavy colour chrome
--line            #D9E1EC  -> neutral
FONT: the design system records Arial as the sole brand font (confirmed
against SEICA_Israel_Template_EN.docx). Barlow / Barlow Condensed appear in
the system only as display faces for large-format collateral - roll-ups and
posters - and are not used here: an RFQ is a Word document that opens on a
customer's machine, where a font that is not installed silently substitutes.
To adopt different values, change them below and nothing else. Every rule
that consumes them lives in scripts/apply_theme.py.
Colours are Word-style RRGGBB hex with no leading '#'.
